title: Unit Event — Lead to Shine More — Episode2 We're Missing Something

meta.Event Outline: With more work offers coming in for MORE MORE JUMP! than they can fulfill, Haruka and the others have a serious talk about their work priorities moving forward.

rows.Line: One hour later
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Alright, let's summarize what we've come up with so far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, we've got spreading hope to others and increasing our media exposure.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We also have, umm...
Whether or not we can appear as a group! That's really important!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. A lot of people will be hearing about MORE MORE JUMP! for the very first time, so we'll want their first impression of us to be that we're a proper idol group.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then there was the matter of leaving enough time for us to keep doing streams.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We've already had to reduce the number we do, so I fear that our fans are going to feel just that much more disappointed if we go any further...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, spreading hope to others through our streams has always been a big deal to us, so we should keep trying to do as many as we can.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: What else is there...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I think we've covered just about everything...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But are there any offers that actually cover all those points?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I doubt there are going to be any that cover all of them, so we might want to order them by importance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With spreading hope to others for sure taking the top spot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Followed by increasing our media exposure. Doing those two things will be the quickest way for us to realize our dream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree with that order.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then, I'll place those two things at the forefront, while also taking the other criteria we've come up with into consideration...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, but...
Would it be alright if I gave this some more thought?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree with what you said in terms of those two things taking top priority, Airi. I don't see anything wrong with that ordering.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like we're still missing something.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We are?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm not sure how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But when I ask myself if choosing work like this will really lead to us making our dream come true, I feel like we're still missing some key piece...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A key piece...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry. I know what I'm saying is really vague...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I know I have a habit of overthinking things in these sorts of situations.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
Your attentiveness has saved our skins a bunch of times already!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's right. If there's something on your mind, Haruka, then I'd also like to think about it with you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, let's take our time and try to come up with a solution that we can all agree on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure we'll be able to figure out what we're missing if we all put our heads together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That being said, we shouldn't keep these people waiting too long. We'll need to set ourselves a deadline, and then decide which offers to accept...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, let's give ourselves until tomorrow.
I promise to have my answer by then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
We'll also take another hard look at things!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
For now, let's adjourn this meeting...
You all have that magazine interview scheduled, so let's start getting ready to head over!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! It's already that late?!
L-Lemme go get my notebook! It has all my answers to their questions in it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, didn't you just put it back in your bag?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez, relax, will you?
A few hours later
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I still can't figure it out...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With spreading hope to others for sure taking the top spot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Followed by increasing our media exposure. Doing those two things will be the quickest way for us to realize our dream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I still don't think what Airi said is wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is it really okay for us to make decisions based on just these criteria?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Will we be able to stand there? Will our fans be able to come see us...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (On that stage...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, what criteria did we use as ASRUN when it came to work?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Mr. Hiiragi always...)
